recipe.ghg_method: GWP100: EDGAR-compatible IPCC AR5 for native CO₂ (1), CH₄ (28) and N₂O (265). Three-gas subtotal only; F-gases absent. Production and direct final-demand accounts are added once; the separate unregistered-waste extension is retained as published, with overlap unverified.
product_tax_rows: Taxes less subsidies on products purchased: Total
recipe.gdp_basis: GDP reconstructed with the source product-tax row
recipe.gdp_note: Value added plus the source's net product taxes, which EXIOBASE Hybrid publishes only as a row on activities. The release has no final-use tax row; as in monetary EXIOBASE 2011, whose final-use tax bridge is zero, none is added. Value added derives from an earlier monetary EXIOBASE vintage.
recipe.value_added_note: Sum of the explicitly listed value-added rows in the source; product taxes and balancing adjustments are excluded.

ghg_coverage.f_gases: not covered: the source HFCs, PFCs and SF6 rows are empty
ghg_coverage.gwp: IPCC AR6 GWP100; mixed CH4 row characterised at the fossil value

recipe.gwp_basis: AR5 (CO2, CH4, N2O only; mixed CH4 origins)
recipe.ghg_note: EXIOBASE Hybrid: this is a three-gas CO2/CH4/N2O subtotal, not a complete GHG inventory. F-gas rows are unavailable; mixed-origin CH4 uses EDGAR-compatible AR5 GWP100 of 28. The source has separate unregistered-waste accounts; their overlap is not independently verified.
recipe.ghg_basis: Producer accounts plus direct final-demand emissions where supplied; AR5 (CO2, CH4, N2O only; mixed CH4 origins)

notes.gross_output: Native MARIO X for IOTs and Xc for SUTs, summed over producing nodes. Gross output includes intermediate production at multiple stages and is not GDP.
notes.domestic_use: Domestic-origin use within the same native region only: matching origin and destination regions in Z and Y (IOT) or U and Yc (SUT). Intermediate and final uses enter once; signed source adjustments are retained.
notes.final_demand: Final demand by consumer region from Y (IOT) or Yc (SUT). Domestic and Imported identify the supplying row region relative to that consumer. A shared SNA category vocabulary is used; native combined categories are never split or duplicated. Households + NPISH combines the observed household and NPISH source columns where separately supplied.
notes.value_added_footprint: Reviewed value added generated by domestic and foreign producers to meet final demand in the selected consumer region. Native direct coefficients retain production origins before MARIO calc_m_from_z solves the system. Multiplication by Y/Yc retains final-consumer columns; no full inverse is constructed.
notes.ghg_footprint: Allocable GHG supported by final demand in the consumer region, plus supplied direct final-user emissions once. MARIO calc_ghg uses the reviewed source characterisation, and calc_f_from_z retains production origins before multiplying by Y/Yc. Direct accounts and upstream requirements outside the representable final-demand boundary stay quantified by production origin. EXIOBASE Hybrid: this is a three-gas CO2/CH4/N2O subtotal, not a complete GHG inventory. F-gas rows are unavailable; mixed-origin CH4 uses EDGAR-compatible AR5 GWP100 of 28. The source has separate unregistered-waste accounts; their overlap is not independently verified.
notes.value_added_trade: Upstream value added embodied in signed gross intermediate and final-use crossings. Domestic and Foreign identify value added generated inside or outside the exporting native region. Total includes both and can closely match gross monetary trade in balanced systems. Repeated border crossings can count the same value added again; this is not value-added exports measured by ultimate foreign final absorption.
notes.ghg_trade: Upstream production GHG embodied in signed gross intermediate and final-use crossings. Repeated border crossings can count the same emissions again. Direct final-user emissions and unrepresented production accounts are not allocated to traded output. EXIOBASE Hybrid: this is a three-gas CO2/CH4/N2O subtotal, not a complete GHG inventory. F-gas rows are unavailable; mixed-origin CH4 uses EDGAR-compatible AR5 GWP100 of 28. The source has separate unregistered-waste accounts; their overlap is not independently verified.
